contexts.text: The fountain in the way to Shur () = the truth which was from the things which proceed from scientifics.
Shur = such a Scientific as is still as it were in the wilderness, that is, which has not as yet acquired life. Explained.
For Shur was in the wilderness not far from the Sea Suph, thus towards Egypt. Illustrated.
The Lord's state when He first instructed Himself in the doctrinals of charity and faith, is signified by Kadesh and Shur (). AC 2502.
Shur = the affection of exterior truth proceeding from scientifics.
From Havillah even to Shur which is upon the face of Egypt in coming to Asshur () = the extension of intelligence.

They went out to the wilderness of Shur () = the state of temptation into which they were then brought... Shur = the scientifics of the Church which have not yet acquired life, thus such things as would acquire life through temptations.
